classification: outcome-informed old-seed architecture calibration; not independent evidence

controller.decision_timing: after all ten local updates in a block; action affects the next block

primary_identifiable_class.theory_reason: signal separated from zero and mixing bounded away from one

descriptive_gates.C1: all endpoints and cells are finite and complete
descriptive_gates.C2: primary geometric cumulative-risk improvement at least 10 percent against the continuous static graph
descriptive_gates.C3: strict primary improvement in at least 80 percent of cells
descriptive_gates.C4: each primary schedule family improves at least 8 percent
descriptive_gates.C5: each delay group improves at least 5 percent
descriptive_gates.C6: primary controller improves at least 10 percent over local learning
descriptive_gates.C8: primary ratio is lower than both low-signal and high-temporal-correlation boundary ratios
descriptive_gates.C9: exactly 240 learning transitions, zero extra probes, and at most 18 messages
descriptive_gates.C10: rho upper increases and effective sample size decreases with temporal correlation
descriptive_gates.C11: positive nonlocal collaboration, finite debt, and mean QP iterations at most 35
